MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE AND LIVESTOCK DEVELOPMENT
Launch of the 2025 long rains National Fertiliser Subsidy Programme.
The price of government subsidised fertiliser will remain at KSh 2,500 per 50kg bag this season.
Registered farmers will receive e-vouchers, which they can redeem at NCPB depots and appointed agro-dealers.
A total of 5 million bags have been secured for the 2025 long rains season.
